subject: Pipeline ledger: reconcile loose amounts, orphan SKUs & refresh commit probabilities
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@acmecorp.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-04-19T14:02:00-07:00
Subject: Pipeline ledger: reconcile loose amounts, orphan SKUs & refresh commit probabilities

Team / Sara —

I pulled the April CRM extract for Acme (attached) and flagged a handful of inconsistencies that will distort our forecast if we don't clean them up this week. Quick summary: 

- Several opportunities (see rows 17, 23, 47) have blank product/SKU fields — likely the legacy quoting fields from Jan/Feb imports.
- Amount in CRM does not match the PO or the quote in our Drive for two line items (discounts not applied uniformly).
- Probability values still reflect initial qualification (30–40%) but opportunity notes indicate technical signoff and procurement activity — these should be reevaluated before Friday's commit.

Primary asks: 
1) Ben & Karthik — please own SKU mapping and amount fixes in the CRM export (I attached crm_extract_ACME_20280418.csv). Add a comment on the deal when you change fields.
2) Lauren — please triage which opportunities should move to Commit vs. Commit-Pending and update next step and close-date estimates.
3) Sara / Acme procurement — can you confirm the PO numbers and whether the discounts in the attached PO are final? If the PO amounts are final, we'll align CRM amounts and re-run ARR math.

Target timeline: please apply CRM edits by EOD Wednesday (2028-04-20) so finance can incorporate updates for the Thursday forecast run. If anything requires a contract amendment, flag it here and I'll loop in legal.

Attachments: crm_extract_ACME_20280418.csv (csv)

Thanks —
Monica Patel
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Sara Lim <sara.lim@acmecorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-19T15:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pipeline ledger: reconcile loose amounts, orphan SKUs & refresh commit probabilities

Thanks Monica — attaching the PO and a quick mapping.

We have two POs relevant: PO 2345 (this quarter) and a draft PO that is still under procurement review (should be final next week). PO 2345 is final and reflects the negotiated 12% volume discount that isn't on the older quote. I highlighted the rows in the PO where the SKU code differs from the one in your extract — see Acme_SKU vs. Redwood_SKU column in the PDF comments.

Attachment: Acme_PO_2345.pdf (pdf)

Date: 2028-04-20T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pipeline ledger: reconcile loose amounts, orphan SKUs & refresh commit probabilities

On it — quick plan: 
- I'll take rows 17 + 23 and apply the Acme_SKU -> Redwood_SKU mapping that Sara highlighted. I'll update the product field and attached quote link in CRM.
- Karthik, can you take row 47 and verify whether that line was split across two SKUs in the PO? If so we should split the CRM line items rather than overwrite a single amount.
- Lauren, after Karthik confirms, please set the stage to Commit-Pending for any deals where procurement has a draft PO, and Commit for PO 2345.

I will leave comments on each deal (BenC: mapping applied) so auditors can trace the change. Expect my changes by 12:30p PT.

Ben
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-20T11:14:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pipeline ledger: reconcile loose amounts, orphan SKUs & refresh commit probabilities

Updated rows in the CRM:
- Row 17: set product SKU = ACME-ENT-XL (was blank), amount adjusted to $249,600 to reflect 12% volume discount.
- Row 23: product SKU = ACME-SERV-BUNDLE, split line into two items to match PO lines, amounts now match PO 2345.
- Row 47: left as draft until Acme confirms the second PO; set probability to 60% (was 35%).

I uploaded the small mapping file to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2bAcmeMapping and left comments on the deals noting the reason for the changes.

— Karthik
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Lim <sara.lim@acmecorp.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-21T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Pipeline ledger: reconcile loose amounts, orphan SKUs & refresh commit probabilities

Thanks everyone — great progress. 

Summary / close loop: 
- CRM changes applied and commented per Karthik & Ben (rows 17, 23, 47).
- Probability updated to 60% on row 47; Lauren will mark Commit vs. Commit-Pending in the next hour.
- Finance will re-run ARR math with these updates for Thursday's forecast.

Sara — can you confirm that the final invoicing will reflect PO 2345 amounts (the $249,600 line and the bundled service split)? If so, we'll move the primary opportunity to Commit. If there are any remaining discounts or a credit to apply, flag here and CC procurement@acmecorp.com.

I'll attach a short note to the HubSpot deal (HS-987654321) with the change log and a copy of crm_update_patch_notes.txt for the auditors.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Monica Patel
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
